items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Was Snowden, Hardwicke, Charlie Irvis and Whetsol, Arthur Whetsol.

ctx.x: Let me see. Then like at that time when Elmer Snowden was in the band, who was the personnel of the band then.
Was Snowden, Hardwicke, Charlie Irvis and Whetsol, Arthur Whetsol.
: Arthur Whetsel, right, and then after Whetsel, Bubber Miley came in the band, right.
